All berries is separately available and mapped to fruit. The combined rate is retained with atlasGroup null, never assigned to nuts or orchard fruit.
Only a mixed category combining failed cropland, idle land and summer fallow is reported. Retained with atlasGroup null; no standalone fallow rate fabricated.
Other small grains (barley, oats, rye, etc.) is a combined category; Land in vegetables is broad. No individual barley, oats, rye or melon rate created.
